class_definitions.fake_evidence_rejected: Claimed or fabricated evidence cannot satisfy a verification gate.
class_definitions.false_pass_blocked: Completion claim blocked when current evidence is absent or contradictory.
class_definitions.false_rewrite_blocked: Rewrite-from-scratch drift blocked when project context should be extended.
class_definitions.generated_view_not_proof: Dashboard, rollup, report, or graph is orientation evidence only.
class_definitions.missing_current_evidence: Only stale, generated, or claimed evidence is available.
class_definitions.synthetic_only_boundary: Synthetic fixtures cannot promote a real-project or production claim.
